descriptionByLocale.en:
Assistant psychologist Work location St. Gallen Job advertisement
• Your tasks and perspectives Taking on diagnostic interviews and psychotherapeutic treatments for our patients after training and a sufficient level of knowledge Working in specific thematic areas Participation in interdisciplinary reports and case discussions Insight into the conceptual structure of new treatment methods and research projects Internal and external supervision
• What you bring to this position Master's degree in psychology Preferably completed psychotherapy training Interest in the diverse tasks in the somatic acute hospital as well as the field of psychosomatics and consultation psychiatry Enjoyment of patient-centered collaboration and exchange in interdisciplinary teams Good observation and perception skills, decision-making skills, quick comprehension and flexibility Ability to work in a team, sense of responsibility and communication skills
• What we offer to you Comprehensive introductory concept Support from an experienced specialist psychologist Versatile job with strong development opportunities Exciting and varied specialist area Interdisciplinary and interprofessional collaboration in one dynamic and constructive, collegial team Attractive regular internal training, further education and training offers Your application Entry on October 1st, 2026. You can find out more about this exciting training from Ms. Lic. phil. Pamela Loosli, Senior Psychologist, Telephone +41 71 494 11 95 If you have any questions about the application process, you can contact Elina Boos, HR Education Specialist, Telephone +41 71 494 27 36 Take advantage of your opportunity and complete your training at HOCH Health Eastern Switzerland About us Healthcare is our profession and our calling. As the largest employer in Eastern Switzerland, we are committed to offering our employees a diverse working environment. We promote individual development and thus make an active contribution to our shared future. We rely on team spirit and interdisciplinary collaboration
